# Verifiable Credentials

# Verifiable Credentials

ThunderID implements **OpenID for Verifiable Presentations (OpenID4VP)** — the protocol for requesting and verifying digital identity credentials held in a user's wallet. Verifiable credentials complement the OAuth 2.1 and OpenID Connect stack: instead of prompting for a username and password, the relying party requests cryptographic proof from an existing government- or institution-issued credential.

For other identity standards, see the [Protocols & Standards](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/guides/guides/protocols/openid4vc/...md) overview.

| Protocol | Spec | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [OpenID for Verifiable Presentations](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/guides/guides/protocols/openid4vc/openid4vp.md) | OpenID4VP draft | Request an SD-JWT VC from a wallet and verify the presentation response in-band. |
